scientific_integrity: The proof is unbounded and elementary: the distinct-prime case reduces the integer parameter to x in {2,3,4} and closes three exact factorizations, while the prime-square case is excluded by a strict interval for sigma(n)/(2n-sigma(n)). The finite verifier is only a regression check.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only semiprime members of the auxiliary set; it does not classify members with three or more prime factors or settle density questions.
title: The unique semiprime in Tóth's auxiliary set is \(15\)
